home.metaDesc: Northgo (formerly Max Seair Logistics) provides freight forwarding, project logistics, warehousing and shipping agency services from 7 offices in Taiwan, Japan, Vietnam and the USA.
home.title: Making logistics effortless.
home.text: Ocean, air, land, project cargo, warehousing and port agency, handled by one accountable team across Asia and the US. You get a clear plan, a clear price and a person who picks up the phone.
home.servicesTitle: One partner for every link in your supply chain.
home.servicesText: Pick a single service or let us run the whole chain. Either way, you deal with one team and one point of contact.
home.whyText: Logistics is a simple concept that the industry has made complicated. We take the complexity on ourselves so your team doesn't have to.

why.title: One accountable team
why.text: A dedicated contact who knows your cargo, your lanes and your deadlines, backed by origin and destination teams.

why.title: Clear, upfront pricing
why.text: Itemised quotes with the surcharges spelled out, so the invoice matches what you approved.

why.title: Customs done right
why.text: Our customs specialists check HS classifications before shipping to prevent delays, penalties and overpaid duties.

why.title: Support around the clock
why.text: Reach our operations team 24 hours a day, 365 days a year, not a ticket queue.

home.networkTitle: Close to your cargo in Asia and the US
home.networkText: Head office in Taipei, with teams in Taichung, Kaohsiung, Tokyo, Osaka, Ho Chi Minh City and Los Angeles, plus a partner network covering every major trade lane.
trustItems: Direct contracts across all major ocean carrier alliances
Quality-vetted trucking partners with shipment tracking
home.ctaText: Tell us what you are shipping and where. A specialist will reply within one business day with options and a quote.

about.metaDesc: Founded in Taipei in 1988 as Max Seair Logistics, Northgo has delivered reliable logistics for over three decades.
about.title: Over three decades of doing logistics right.
about.intro: Northgo was founded in Taipei in 1988 as Max Seair Logistics Inc. In November 2024 we became Northgo: a new name, the same people and the same commitment to our clients.
about.vision: To be the most trusted name in logistics.
about.mission: Making logistics effortless, so our clients can focus on growing their business.
about.valuesIntro: Our north star: doing the right thing matters more than doing things right.

values.title: Customer first
values.text: Every decision starts with the value it creates for our clients. We listen first, then deliver.

values.title: Integrity and transparency
values.text: Trust is earned through honesty and consistency. Clients always know where their cargo and their money stand.

values.title: Innovation and excellence
values.text: We keep improving our processes and tools so our clients stay competitive.

values.title: Sustainability and responsibility
values.text: We look for better ways to reduce our environmental impact and support the communities we serve.

timeline.title: Founded in Taipei
timeline.text: Max Seair Logistics Inc. opens in Taipei with a mission to bring reliability to freight forwarding.

timeline.title: Expanding across Asia and the US
timeline.text: New offices in Taichung, Kaohsiung, Tokyo, Osaka, Ho Chi Minh City and Los Angeles.

timeline.title: Max Seair becomes Northgo
timeline.text: On 11 November 2024 we rebranded as Northgo to reflect where we are heading. Our team and our commitments stay the same.

timeline.title: 7 offices, 4 countries
timeline.text: Freight, project, warehouse and shipping agency services, with operations support 24/7.

about.changedText: The name on the door. Northgo represents our commitment to progress and to serving clients better in a fast-changing industry.
about.sameText: Our people, our expertise and our dedication to you, the same standards we have upheld for more than three decades.
